summary: 40 judged: 21 PASS, 19 FAIL. No fabricated quotes; several line numbers are off by a few (Weave:203 is :200, Weave:57 is :54, Daily Page:7 is :8) and one reading is wrong (Spinoza.md:16 does not make the monad's claim). The failures fall into three kinds. Eleven are stale: the folder-ops reader worked from a snapshot older than this weave and proposed labels for links it called bare that already carry a label in the same register (Walk/Weave, Self-Model/Weave, Substrate Skill x2, Palace Map/Pheromone, Ceremonies/SCHEMA, Walk/Cooperation Path, Deposit/README, both diagram standards/README, Pages as Agents/Reference); the same stale premise also wrongly says each ceremony carries a bare link to the hub, though the member-of moves are right. Six rest on prose that does not exist yet: a third page, a non-canon transcript, or a sentence the reader admits is still owed in Pile B (Graffiti/Substrate Skill, Sentry/Skills, Moderator/Dialectic, Archive/Compression, Ceremonies/CHILD, Daily Page/question). Two are wrong types: couples-with for a one-way flow (Harvest to Deposit), and deepens for a page that applies a rule rather than elaborating it (Return to CHILD).
